steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Conflict of the Orders (494-287 BC) was the struggle between patricians and plebeians for political equality | Key Fact: The First Secession (494 BC): plebeians withdrew to the Sacred Mount, forcing the patricians to create the tribunes of the plebs | Key Fact: The Twelve Tables (451-450 BC): Rome's first written law code, created because plebeians were being judged by unwritten patrician customs | Key Fact: The Licinian-Sextian Laws (367 BC) required one consul to be a plebeian; the office was opened to plebeians

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the conflict of the orders, and one past-paper question.
